items.reason: Scope: more personnel and armaments stationed on Taiping extends the 2020 military reinforcement, which was confined to Pratas (ev-a831186d56, ev-2d967b5f45), to the Spratly outpost (rests on TW-2016-2020's undecided 2020 candidates in the prev file). Lead of the 2021 island-defence build-up.

Reconstruction of the Dongsha runway to strengthen the islands' defence (approved Feb 2020): part of the 2021 defence build-up led by ev-fb9e3a0cf7; no construction on Pratas is in the 2020 record (rests on TW-2016-2020's undecided 2020 candidates in the prev file). A coder may instead make it a separate construction move.
MND statement that the defences on Pratas and Itu Aba can deter invasion: the declarative face of the 2021 build-up led by ev-fb9e3a0cf7, not a separate intensification.

Novelty: an official threat to open fire on Chinese drones entering Pratas restricted airspace is a new, coercive method; the 2020 record shows reinforcement and fishing detentions (ev-a831186d56, ev-3931cebc72) but no threat of fire (rests on TW-2016-2020's undecided 2020 candidates in the prev file).

Dongsha garrison's routine quarterly live-fire training in 2021 continues 2020's ev-8649852916; the September test of an indigenous anti-armour rocket is a weapons detail, not a change of practice (rests on TW-2016-2020's undecided 2020 candidates in the prev file).
First Taiping live-fire drill of 2021: same quarterly practice as 2020's first drill ev-f41ed3da70 (rests on TW-2016-2020's undecided 2020 candidates in the prev file).

Fourth-quarter 2021 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2020's ev-f41ed3da70 (rests on TW-2016-2020's undecided 2020 candidates in the prev file) (not a duplicate of the Dongsha summary ev-2482d8ceca — a different island and command).
First Taiping live-fire drill of 2022: same quarterly practice as 2021's first drill ev-3d4dd88865. Four notices against two found for 2021 reflects the CGA's online list, not a change.
Dongsha quarterly live-fire training in 2022 continues 2021's ev-2482d8ceca at the same level.
MOFA rebuttal of the TAO's warning with a sovereignty reaffirmation: a same-level verbal assertion, like 2021's MND statement of resolve to defend the islands ev-c00bfcbcbb.
Second-quarter 2022 Taiping drill with Taiwan's rebuff of the Philippine objection; same quarterly practice as ev-3d4dd88865 (2021) — the Philippine protest is new, Taiwan's conduct is not.
Third-quarter 2022 Taiping drill; same quarterly practice as 2021's ev-3d4dd88865.
Fourth-quarter 2022 Taiping drill; same quarterly practice as 2021's ev-3d4dd88865.

Formal MOFA rebuttal of Vietnam's protest over the November drill; a routine same-level verbal assertion. The 2021 record has no MOFA rebuttal, so the nearest same-level statement is ev-c00bfcbcbb; a coder may prefer unclear.
First Taiping live-fire drill of 2023: same quarterly practice as 2022's first drill ev-0fd48ae162.
Dongsha live-fire training in 2023 continues 2022's ev-b4cd83ea06 (three notices found against four; no sign of a change).
Second-quarter 2023 Taiping drill; same quarterly practice as 2022's ev-0fd48ae162.
MOFA rebuttal of Vietnam's protest over the June drill repeats 2022's rebuttal ev-8bca16eb68; more rebuttals because Vietnam protested more is not a frequency move.

MOFA sovereignty reaffirmation in reaction to China's Triton airstrip: the same kind of response to a rival's act as 2022's ev-f97a9559f5; the Paracels are within the standing claim, so no wider claim.
Third-quarter 2023 Taiping drill ('routine, several times a year'); same practice as 2022's ev-0fd48ae162.
MOFA rebuttal of Vietnam's protest over the August drill; same as 2022's ev-8bca16eb68.

Novelty (new again): a visit by two cabinet ministers to Dongsha, watching a CGA chase of Chinese trawlers; nothing comparable in the 2022 record (only drills and MOFA statements), though such visits occurred in earlier years — a weak move, a coder may reject it as low-level.
Fourth-quarter 2023 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2022's ev-0fd48ae162.
Dongsha quarterly live-fire training in 2024 continues 2023's ev-8a50700e2d.

Novelty: completion of the NT$1.7bn harbour dredging and wharf rebuild at Taiping, letting 4,000-tonne cutters berth (Miaoli berthed for the ceremony); no construction on Taiping is in the 2023 record.
First Taiping live-fire drill of 2024: same quarterly practice as 2023's first drill ev-e023041889.
Legislators flown to Taiping to declare sovereignty and inspect the pier: an official sovereignty visit at the same level as the 2023 ministerial visit to Dongsha ev-1cbd802dd7.
Second-quarter 2024 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2023's ev-e023041889.
MOFA rejection of the Philippine and Vietnamese CLCS submissions: the same response-to-rival-acts statement as 2023's ev-ab91707076.
Third-quarter 2024 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2023's ev-e023041889.
Fourth-quarter 2024 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2023's ev-e023041889.

Formal statement rejecting the Philippine Maritime Zones Act and China's Scarborough baselines: same kind of response to rivals' acts as 2023's ev-ab91707076; issued as a 聲明, but no new claim or method.
Dongsha quarterly live-fire training in 2025 continues 2024's ev-4738608463.

Novelty: shadowing, warning and pushing China Coast Guard ships out of Dongsha restricted waters (33 incursions in 2025) is a new coercive method; the 2024 record has no enforcement at all. Lead of the 2025 Dongsha enforcement move.
Expelling CCG-escorted Chinese fishing fleets and boarding Yueraoyu 23588 while CCG ships tried to intervene: part of the 2025 Dongsha enforcement led by ev-80e8827849.
MOFA condemnation of a PLA act at Scarborough with the standard position restated: same kind of statement as 2024's ev-7f094b7119 on Scarborough.

Water cannon against a Chinese fishing boat, with 111 expulsions and 7 seizures since January: part of the 2025 Dongsha enforcement led by ev-80e8827849; a coder could split the fishing enforcement (water cannon, a new method against the 2024 record) into its own move.
First Taiping drill of 2025 in the record (second-quarter notice): same quarterly practice as 2024's first drill ev-74d1adf77e.
Third-quarter 2025 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2024's ev-74d1adf77e.

Novelty: a navy squadron's call at Taiping with the 10,000-tonne Panshi berthing, the first publicised berthing of a ship that size; the 2024 record shows only a CGA cutter at the new wharf (ev-3282711eb9) and no naval presence. Could instead be read as use of the 2024 port works (continuation of ev-3282711eb9).

Formal statement rejecting China's Scarborough nature reserve: same kind of formal rejection of a rival's act at Scarborough as 2024's ev-7f094b7119; the sharper 'our Minzhu Reef' wording is not a wider claim.
Seizure of a Chinese fishing boat and expulsion of a CCG ship from Dongsha restricted waters, with the minister's pledge of more detentions: part of the 2025 Dongsha enforcement led by ev-80e8827849.
Fourth-quarter 2025 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2024's ev-74d1adf77e.
MND condemnation of a PLA drone over Dongsha: a same-level verbal protest like 2025's MOFA condemnation of a PLA act, ev-0f055336ea; no physical response reported.
Confronting and expelling CCG ships at Dongsha through 2026 (13 intrusions by October against 33 in 2025): continues 2025's ev-80e8827849 by the same method.
First Taiping live-fire drill of 2026: same quarterly practice as 2025's first drill ev-ea6221479b.
Dongsha quarterly live-fire training in 2026 continues 2025's ev-a5225c9e6a.

OAC minister's visit to Taiping for the 'Nanyuan No. 9' exercise with a simulated armed boarding: no 2025 exercise or ministerial visit is in the record, but the numbering implies a yearly exercise; settles on whether Nanyuan No. 8 was held in 2025 (then continuation) — the armed-boarding element could make it a novelty move.

Confronting CCG 3501 and surging the frigate CG-129 to Pratas against a joint CCG-survey ship operation: the Chinese operation is new, Taiwan's response is the 2025 practice of ev-80e8827849 at the same level.
Second-quarter 2026 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2025's ev-ea6221479b.

Scope: expelling Chinese government vessels from restricted waters extends the 2025 Dongsha practice (ev-80e8827849) to Taiping in the Spratlys, the first such expulsion there. Provisional: it answers the first Chinese intrusion at Taiping, so a strict counterfactual reading would make it a continuation of ev-80e8827849.
MOFA condemnation of the 11 June Taiping intrusion: the declarative side of the same incident as ev-19311e4a9e.
Novelty: renovating the Dongsha pier and permanently basing new 100-tonne patrol ships there; the 2025 record shows enforcement sorties and drills at Dongsha but no construction or permanent basing.
Tenth-anniversary MOFA restatement of the claim and Tsai's 2016 principles: same level as 2025's formal statement ev-5c2db4f1ee.
Foreign Minister's restatement in the legislature that Taiping is an island: a routine reaffirmation of a 2016 position, same level as 2025's ev-5c2db4f1ee.
Third-quarter 2026 Taiping firing notice; same quarterly practice as 2025's ev-ea6221479b.
Water cannon against a Chinese fishing boat inside Dongsha restricted waters, then towing it out: same method as 2025's water-cannon expulsion ev-6bed3c3961.
